name: Settlement Data Volume 2
definition: Aggregated values and volumes of settlements instructions for a specific type of financial instruments, type of transaction, type of clients, and cash transfers.

Volume.name: Volume
Volume.definition: Specifies the aggregated volume of settlement instructions, in terms of failed, settled transactions and total transactions.

Value.name: Value
Value.definition: Specifies the aggregated value of settlement instructions, in terms of failed, settled transactions and total transactions.
